contentHtml:
AI is not science fiction any more. It is in your phone's camera, your email spam filter and the checkout down the road. I run friendly, face-to-face sessions and one-on-one coaching around Stretton and Brisbane that take you from "I have heard of ChatGPT" to actually using it to save time and spark ideas.

Zero jargon, just practical skills

Plain-English explanations that suit beginners and curious seniors. I cover privacy, Australian data rules and sensible, responsible use from the start, and I am not tied to any one tool, so you can try ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, Midjourney, Canva or Google Gemini and see what fits, with no brand bias.

Learn on your own device, at your own pace

Draft emails automatically, sharpen up your marketing copy, or put together a simple chatbot, all on your own laptop or phone so you walk away able to do it again. I offer a short intro session, a half-day small-business workshop, or private coaching over a video call or in person.

Where it goes next

If AI could answer your business phones while you work, see my AI receptionist service. And if it is broader everyday tech you want to get on top of, there is general tech advice and computer training.

Send me the details for a quote or call 0477 319 160, with no call-out fee anywhere on Stretton.
